messages:
harry_docs: quick ask  PR changing an SDK snippet (docs/snippets/python_auth.md) to use the new ConnectClient. purely a docs code change but snippet-runner fails because preview runner image is pinned to v1.2. can we fast-track this without CODEOWNERS blocking it?

leah_engineer: what's failing in preview? snippet-runner job or lint?

harry_docs: snippet-runner fails with ModuleNotFoundError: redwood.connect. lint/build are fine; runner image doesn't have new package.

maria_security: security note  any example referencing new SDK surface needs a quick check for secret leaks. otherwise OK.

leah_engineer: we shouldn't bypass snippet tests. propose: add docs-snippets team to CODEOWNERS so a single team approval counts, and automate labeling for tiny snippet-only PRs (<=3 files, <=30 lines). only allow auto-label when author is in org and snippet-runner passes.

staging-bot: preview queued for PR #4402. snippet-runner: failed.

harry_docs: updated plan: 1) add @redwood/docs-snippets to CODEOWNERS for docs/snippets/*, 2) add GitHub Action to auto-label docs/trivial when criteria met and author in org, 3) require snippet-runner green before auto-merge, 4) ops to bump snippet-runner weekly. I'll draft PRs.

leah_engineer: +1. Action should not run on forks and must re-run preview if runner image updated. Also add an explanation field in PR template: "trivial-reason".

maria_security: I'll sign off on CODEOWNERS once the PR template includes a short security checklist (no secrets, no external keys).

ci-bot: infra ticket #87 opened: bump/snippet-runner-image by @ops.

harry_docs: thanks. aim to land changes today so PR #4402 can merge after runner update. will ping when PRs are up.

leah_engineer: one more: ensure auto-merge respects release freeze windows. ops will monitor first week and revert if issues observed.
